description: Trigger cases for the merged skill (drive-usage + google-drive-archive + the archive skill repurposed as the docs.local lifecycle). None of the three had filing/archival evals; the archive skill's Ralph-PRD evals were removed with it (Q-H).

evals.prompt: I just finished a 40-page audit and three research prompts in docs.local/. Where should each go in Brain Drive, and what should they be named?
evals.expected_output: Uses the Brain Drive folder model and decision tree: research prompts/results to 03_RESEARCH/Active/<topic>/, the finished heavy audit through the archive procedure to 06_ARCHIVE/audits/<topic>/<date>/, date-prefixed kebab-case names, and a _DRIVE-LEDGER.md pointer left in docs.local/.

assertions.name: heavy-audit-to-06-archive
assertions.description: The heavy audit goes through the archive procedure to 06_ARCHIVE

evals.prompt: Archive this: a 300MB interview recording, its transcript, and a 16kHz downsample I made for whisper.
evals.expected_output: Runs the archive procedure: uploads the original recording and the transcript (not the regeneratable downsample, which is listed with its ffmpeg command), brain_digests the transcript, writes the _DRIVE-LEDGER.md row, and deletes the local heavy copy only after listFolder confirms the upload.

assertions.name: originals-only
assertions.description: Uploads originals; lists the downsample as regeneratable instead of uploading it

assertions.name: delete-after-verify
assertions.description: Local deletion only after listFolder confirms the upload and the ledger is written

evals.prompt: docs.local cleanup: this repo's docs.local is a wall of dated MD files and a .codex-home-test folder with an auth.json in it. Tidy it up.
evals.expected_output: Applies the docs.local lifecycle: dated daily items roll up into YYYY-MM/ folders and months older than N go to Brain Drive through the archive procedure. The .codex-home-test directory and its auth.json are credentials: never uploaded, moved or deleted, and reported as skipped: credential <path> for the owner to decide.

assertions.name: monthly-rollup
assertions.description: Daily items roll up into YYYY-MM/ folders

assertions.name: old-months-to-drive
assertions.description: Months older than N go to Brain Drive via the archive procedure

assertions.name: credentials-untouched
assertions.description: auth.json / .codex-home* are skipped and reported, never uploaded, moved or deleted
